title: Two Town tabs: the stale tab erases the other tab's resources, achievements and lifetime stats (last writer wins)
steps: Open http://localhost:9463/game/index.html, Join Town (or Play offline) as X
Open the same URL in a second tab (same browser) and join as X
Tab A: chop 5 wood (gainResource('wood',1) x5): pixeltown-save-v1.resources.wood = 5
Tab B (still open): pick 2 fruit
Close both tabs and reopen the Town
expected: wood 5 and fruit 2 are both kept (and both tabs' lifetimeStats / achievements)
actual: stored resources = {wood:0, fruit:2}; lifetimeStats.wood gone. Tab B writes its whole in-memory resources / lifetimeStats / achievementsUnlocked objects over Tab A's. No 'open in another tab' warning, no storage listener in main.js.
suspect: game/main.js:158 writeSave (spread of whole sub-objects) + main.js:2531 saveResources; no window 'storage' listener in main.js

title: Restoring a backup in the Lantern while a Town tab is open: the Town tab overwrites the restored resources, achievements and stats on its next action
steps: Tab 1: Town open (new player, 0 resources)
Tab 2: /game/games/mad-maze/lantern.html -> Restore -> pick a backup whose town save has wood 12, stone 7, achievements craft1+fish1, lifetimeStats wood 40 -> Confirm ('Restored 1 saved item')
Back to Tab 1: catch one fish
Read pixeltown-save-v1
expected: the restored progress stays (wood 12 ... plus the new fish), or the Restore screen tells the player to close other game tabs first
actual: resources = {wood:0, stone:0, fish:1, ...}, achievementsUnlocked = [], lifetimeStats = {fish:1}: the restore is silently undone. The Restore confirm says nothing about other tabs.
suspect: game/main.js:2531 saveResources / incrementStat writes stale in-memory objects; game/games/mad-maze/lantern.js:300 confirmRestore has no cross-tab notice (BroadcastChannel 'reload' or a storage listener in main.js would fix it)

title: Town '📂 Restore' accepts the full Lantern backup file and writes the bundle object AS the town save: the whole town save is wiped
steps: Lantern (/game/games/mad-maze/lantern.html) -> 'Back up my progress' -> mad-maze-backup.json
Town -> More -> '📂 Restore' -> choose that mad-maze-backup.json
Page says 'Save restored! Reloading…'
expected: either the Town restore understands the full backup format (MMBackup.plan/apply) or refuses it
actual: pixeltown-save-v1 becomes {format:'pixeltown-backup', v:2, keys:{...}}: name, species, resources, museum, achievements, realm all gone from the town save; the join screen is shown again. importSave accepts ANY JSON object with no validation or cleaning.
suspect: game/main.js:4354-4369 importSave (JSON.parse + setItem of anything that is an object)

title: One corrupt key makes the whole backup file unrestorable, and the player only learns it on the new device
steps: Have normal progress; one minor key is corrupt (e.g. pixeltown-gift-v1 = '{"v":1,"days":3,' after a truncated write)
Lantern -> Back up my progress (succeeds, says 'Backup file saved. Keep it somewhere safe.')
New device / cleared storage: Lantern -> Restore -> that file
expected: everything valid is restored; the broken daily-gift entry is skipped or reset and named
actual: 'The daily gift in that backup is not valid, so nothing was changed.' The 33 good entries (town, realm, heroes, hub...) cannot be restored at all. bundle() exports raw values unchecked, plan() fails the whole file on the first bad key.
suspect: game/shared/mm-backup.js:120 bundle (raw, no check) and :172-181 plan (return fail on any key). Fix: validate at export and warn, and/or let plan skip a bad key (list it in the confirm) instead of failing all

title: Two different Backup buttons: the Town's '💾 Backup' saves only the town save, not Realm world, heroes, Hub, Isles, tames or any game
steps: Play the Realm, Hub, Isles, some mini games
Town -> More -> '💾 Backup' ('Download a backup of your local save')
New device: Town -> Restore that file
expected: one full backup (MMBackup.bundle, 34+ keys) from every Backup button
actual: the Town file holds only pixeltown-save-v1 (982 bytes in my run); Realm world, heroes/stash, Hub map, Isles, tames, medals and all mini-game bests are lost on the new device. The full backup only exists inside the Mad Maze Lantern, which a Town player will not find.

title: Same-device co-op: both seats write the whole pixeltown-realm-v1, so the last mover's state wins (seat 0's position lost; chests/quests/events at risk)
steps: Tab A: /game/games/mad-maze/index.html?mode=world&party=local&seed=b14coop&seat=0
Tab B: same with seat=1 (both see 1 partner ghost, 'Hero 1 · 36t' tag)
A walks east 22 tiles, then B walks west 15 tiles
Close both, open the Realm solo
expected: each seat's progress is kept (or co-op saves are merged)
actual: stored pos = B's tile (26,172) although A stood at (63,172); A reopens at B's spot. realm-world writeSave writes the whole in-memory save (only `finds` is merged), so chests, evDone, quests and stats from the other seat can be overwritten the same way (code reading; position proven).

title: Remote names: zero-width characters kept, duplicates of your own name and '[Server] ...' allowed (easy impersonation)
steps: Town with the fake-SDK harness (net-hostile-presence pattern)
Emit presence records named 'ADMINb14a' (= my own name), 'a\u200b\u200b\u200bb', '[Server] Reset'
expected: invisible characters stripped; a clash with an existing name gets a suffix or a marker
actual: a second 'ADMINb14a' tag and list line (top-scores board then shows the same name twice), 'a​​​b' renders as 'ab', '[Server] Reset' is shown like a system name. UNSAFE_TEXT_CHARS strips bidi/control but not U+200B-200F, U+2060-2064, U+FEFF.

title: 16-character name cap splits ZWJ emoji and combining marks (comment says it never does)
expected: cut on grapheme boundaries (Intl.Segmenter) or by visible width
actual: tag reads '👨‍👩‍👧‍👦👨‍👩‍👧‍👦👨‍' (dangling ZWJ); Zalgo names are cut mid-cluster
suspect: game/net.js:34-35 cleanText (Array.from = code points, not graphemes)

title: Player list: 16 wide characters overflow under the heart button; an RTL name flips the score to the left
steps: Remote names 'ＷＷＷＷＷＷＷＷＷＷＷＷＷＷＷＷ', 'WWWWWWWWWWWWWWWW', 'مرحبا بالجميع'
Look at the IN TOWN list (desktop)
expected: long names ellipsize before the bestie heart; each line keeps 'name — ⭐score' order
actual: WWWW line runs under/over the 🤍 button and wraps; the Arabic line shows '0⭐ — مرحبا بالجميع' (needs dir=auto / <bdi> on the name span)

title: Presence cap draws 60 but the player list lists every record (101 lines for 100 fake players)
steps: Emit 100 valid presence records
expected: list matches what is drawn, or shows '+40 more'
actual: 60 sprites (REMOTE_CAP works, refills correctly after leaves, churn of 300 add/remove leaves no leaked objects), but 101 list items; a flood makes the list unbounded

title: A second invite that arrives while one is showing is deleted and never shown; its sender gets no answer
steps: Friend invites me to a duel (toast shows)
Friend2 invites me to a 2v2 a moment later
Accept/decline the first
expected: the second invite is queued (or the sender is told I am busy)
actual: the 2v2 invite is removed from realmInvites/{me} and never appears; Friend2 waits until it expires
suspect: game/main.js:3512 acceptNetInvite (returns false while realmInviteIn) + net.js read-once delete

title: Voice memos from non-besties are ignored but never deleted, so they stay world-readable in walkie/{me}
steps: Pick a bestie
Someone else pushes a valid memo to walkie/{me}
expected: dropped and removed (netsafety P1-2 fix text: snap.ref.remove())
actual: ignored client-side (good: not played) but the record stays in the DB; only bestie memos are removed after playing

title: Backup leaves out settings, including accessibility ones (reduce motion, high contrast, mute, aim assist, auto-fire)
steps: Turn on reduce motion + high contrast + auto-fire
Lantern Backup, restore on a new device
actual: not in the file: mm-reduce-motion, mm-high-contrast, mm-sfx-muted, mm-music, mm-aim-assist, mm-auto-fire, mm-bullet-shapes, pixeltown-realm-audio-v1. Also mm-auto-fire is missing from SAVE-KEYS.md.
